events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first broadcast.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, a channel changed music forever. MTV hit our screens, kicking off with The Buggles. What was your favourite music video moment from the early days?

events.title: Woodstock Festival
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on August 15, 1969, bringing hundreds of thousands to Bethel, New York, for "3 Days of Peace & Music."

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and incredible music. Which iconic performance would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! The voice of The Pretenders, still rocking. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The iconic voice of Oasis. What's your favourite track featuring his distinctive vocals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over 60 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond actor and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Musician, singer, and songwriter John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which of his songs resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?
